subject.title: [Feature]: Import Codex and Claude Code memory from Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a provider-neutral Control UI memory-import workflow now, and if so should the first scope include both provider changes and the complete web plan/apply experience?
rationale: The request is aligned with setup and web ergonomics, but it adds a new privacy-sensitive Gateway/UI capability and requires maintainers to choose scope, ownership, and sequencing before implementation.

options.title: Ship the staged full flow
options.body: Extend both providers with memory items, then add a generic Gateway RPC and Control UI wizard with strict privacy and backup guarantees.

options.title: Provider support first
options.body: Add memory items to the existing CLI providers now and defer the Control UI surface until the provider contracts have shipped and stabilized.

options.title: Keep CLI and manual import
options.body: Do not add a web import surface and retain current CLI/manual migration paths for this private-data workflow.

recommendation.title: Ship the staged full flow
recommendation.body: Extend both providers with memory items, then add a generic Gateway RPC and Control UI wizard with strict privacy and backup guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans product scope, Control UI, migration behavior, and privacy policy, matching the repository product-lead role documented in CONTRIBUTING.md. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md?utm_source=openai))
